checklist.criterion: Correct diagnostic-first command named: `tsc --noEmit --extendedDiagnostics` (or equivalent, e.g. `--generateTrace`) is named as the first step, before any config change
Explains why diagnosing first is correct: The document explains that changing `include`/`exclude` before profiling risks missing the actual cause
Lists at least three concrete diagnostic outputs: e.g. files checked, instantiation count, memory usage, or check time breakdown
Recommends at least two concrete, non-destructive responses: e.g. project references, capping recursion depth, or narrowing scope deliberately based on evidence
Explicitly rules out disabling strict checks for speed: The document states that disabling `strict` or a strictness flag to improve performance is not an acceptable fix
